decisions.subject: FOMO ordering — socialProofAngle selection
decisions.default: No ordering — competitorFOMO[] used in the sequence Vera wrote them
decisions.change: Ordered by time-saved (hours/people recovered, largest first) per ivy.json psychologyProfile.socialProofAngle = 'time-saved' (primary profile: operational-pragmatist). Rank: Carnegie Learning (92% research time) → Anonymized flooring company ($25K/2,000+ invoices) → Industry benchmark (30% productivity/60% error) → Wiley (213% ROI/40% efficiency) → McGraw-Hill (evening entry eliminated) → HMH (50% digital) → Pearson (full Agentforce) → Savvas (GSV 150/parent signal)

decisions.subject: fomoAngle rewrite — Carnegie Learning
decisions.default: Lead with Agentforce capability and company name: 'Carnegie Learning deployed Agentforce to automate account research — 92% reduction in research time.'
decisions.change: Rewritten to lead with hours/task eliminated per operational-pragmatist fomoFraming. New lead: '92% of the time Carnegie Learning's K-12 reps spent preparing for district calls — gone on go-live.' Company name moved to sentence two. AI framing removed from the hook.
decisions.driver: ivy.json contentLayers.champion.fomoFraming: 'Lead with hours saved and the specific manual task that disappears. No AI framing needed for the hook.'

decisions.subject: fomoAngle rewrite — Anonymized flooring company
decisions.default: Lead with dollar figure: '$25,000 saved on manual data entry annually by automating Salesforce ↔ QuickBooks sync.'
decisions.change: Rewritten to name the specific task that stops on go-live day per operational-pragmatist lens. New lead: '$25,000 in annual billing labor eliminated by automating exactly the workflow Crystal runs today.' Added explicit go-live day framing: 'That specific task — Crystal toggling between two systems for every agreement — stops on go-live day.'
decisions.driver: ivy.json contentLayers.champion.fomoFraming + challengeFraming: name the exact manual task and the person doing it

decisions.subject: challengeLead — skepticism-first structure
decisions.default: Lead with primaryPainQuote verbatim as the emotional anchor, then name the operational consequence.
decisions.change: Skepticism signals detected in ivy.json (3 signals: 'don't want to get excited too early', 'I just need time to really think about it', 'potentially failure-prone layers'). Challenge lead acknowledges friction first ('there are real questions left to answer: QB Online or Desktop, where Holly's spreadsheets live...') before delivering the verbatim primaryPainQuote anchor. Secondary roi-analytical profile contribution applied: cost anchor added ('At 15 to 30 minutes per agreement, across a back-to-school pipeline that compresses into 60 days — that is the labor cost of the status quo, running every cycle').
decisions.driver: hawk.toml principle: 'If skepticismSignals are present: acknowledge the friction FIRST — do not open with the solution.' + ivy.json blendNote: 'secondary profile contributes one element: challenge.lead includes a cost anchor'

decisions.subject: closingLine — AgentForce override triggered
decisions.default: operational-pragmatist closingLineVariant: 'Stage 1 eliminates the specific manual work your team does today. Stages 2 and 3 build on that foundation — but the immediate win is on go-live day.'
decisions.change: AgentForce-specific closing line applied because flo.json flags.salesforceDetected = true. Override: 'The Salesforce objects and MuleSoft event triggers established in Year 1 are what AgentForce reads in Year 2. That architecture is decided once.' This overrides both the operational-pragmatist closingLineVariant and the default proposal-structure.md closing line.
decisions.driver: hawk.toml principle: 'If Salesforce detected (flo.json flags.salesforceDetected = true): override both variants with an AgentForce-specific closing line'

decisions.subject: journeyHeadline — aspirationQuote callback
decisions.change: aspirationQuote is not null in sage.json: 'Over the last 5 years, what have we spent on Intensified Algebra - Volume 1 SABs? How many did we source each year? How many of them remain in inventory at any given time?' journeyHeadline written as: 'the path to answering "what have we spent on Intensified Algebra Vol 1 over the last five years?" in Salesforce, without calling Holly.' Holly named explicitly because the current state requires a phone call to Holly to answer this question — the headline anchors the journey in the specific friction Maria described.
decisions.driver: hawk.toml principle: 'Write a journey.headline callback: the path to [their aspiration, in their words].' sage.json quotes.aspirationQuote

decisions.subject: fomoAngleForSecondary — roi-analytical secondary profile applied across all 8 FOMO entries
decisions.default: Single fomoAngleAdapted per entry (primary operational-pragmatist lens only)
decisions.change: ivy.json secondaryProfile = 'roi-analytical' (not null). fomoAngleForSecondary generated for all 8 fomoOrdered[] entries using roi-analytical fomoFraming: 'Lead with the dollar amount or hours recovered. Name the number before naming the company.' Key rewrites: Carnegie Learning secondary leads with '92% reduction... at a minimum of 4+ reps doing district outreach, that is hours of daily productive selling time recovered'; Anonymized flooring secondary leads with '$25,000 saved annually. 2,000+ invoices automated'; Industry benchmark secondary converts Crystal's time to a dollar estimate ('50 hours of billing labor per year doing nothing but moving data that already exists in Salesforce'). Petra uses fomoAngleAdapted for champion-facing challenge section; fomoAngleForSecondary for executive summary where Linda (ROI-analytical economic buyer) is the primary reader.
decisions.driver: hawk.toml principle: 'Multi-profile FOMO — when ivy.json psychologyProfile.secondaryProfile is not null.' ivy.json economicBuyer.profile = 'roi-analytical' (Linda) confirms fomoAngleForSecondary routes to executive summary.

decisions.subject: competitivePositioning — block omitted
decisions.default: Generate competitivePositioning block when sage.json signal='competitive-evaluation' OR ivy.json detects 'systematic-evaluator' as primary or secondary profile
decisions.change: Neither trigger present. sage.json signals: ['real-time', 'scheduled', 'file / Excel', 'batch'] — no 'competitive-evaluation'. ivy.json primaryProfile = 'operational-pragmatist', secondaryProfile = 'roi-analytical' — no 'systematic-evaluator'. competitivePositioning block omitted from hawk.json.
decisions.driver: hawk.toml principle: 'If no competitive-evaluation signal: omit the competitivePositioning block entirely.'
